# Atmosphère patches

Copied from [Ultra-NX/Ultra-Resources](https://github.com/Ultra-NX/Ultra-Resources/tree/main/patches/Atmosphere)
at commit `6cb1edb803c1ee42de72fae3fcec2550cfe1fdfa`.

Applied in order by `.github/workflows/build.yml` (list in `.github/components.json`).

`0004-40MB-for-emunand.patch` is intentionally left out: it does not apply to 1.12.1,
and per the UltraNX 3.1 "Plus" changelog Atmosphère 1.12.1 on HOS 23+ already provides those 40 MB.
